newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-REPLAYS FOR BOTH SCOTTISH CUP SEMIFINALS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-REPLAYS FOR BOTH SCOTTISH CUP SEMIFINALS.

text.p: Kilmarnock and Dundee United must replay their Scottish F.A. Cup semifinal after a dreary 0-0 draw on Monday.
Kilmarnock's David Bagan came closest to scoring in the second half when his cross from the right bounced off the top of the bar.
United's Dutch goalkeeper Sieb Dykstra saved well from Jim McIntyre and Kevin McGowne.
The replay was scheduled for April 22.
Saturday's semifinal between Celtic and Falkirk was drawn 1-1 and will be re-staged on April 23.
